deprecated_tags.reason: include shares parent scope and harms performance; render enforces strict isolated scope.
image_url provides superior responsive width/height cropping and WebP/AVIF auto-negotiation.

deprecated_tags.rule: Must be placed in <head> of layout/theme.liquid; never manipulated or removed.

essential_tags_2026.description: Renders nested blocks assigned in theme customizer.
Renders snippet with isolated variable bindings: {% render 'snippet-name', prop: value %}.
Scoped asset injection evaluated by Shopify edge servers.
Must contain valid RFC 8259 JSON describing section/block customization UI.

modern_filters.description: Dynamic CDN image resizing with automatic format negotiation.

modern_filters.usage: image | image_tag: loading: 'lazy', fetchpriority: 'auto', sizes: sizes

modern_filters.description: Escapes Liquid object into valid JSON string.
Formats monetary value per merchant currency settings.

context_objects.description: Resolves closest parent product context when a block is nested in generic containers.
Provides localized dynamic routing URLs (e.g. routes.cart_url, routes.cart_add_url).
Identifies active template (product, collection, cart, index, etc.).

theme_blocks_2_0.title: Theme Blocks 2.0 Architecture Specification

nesting_rules.app_block_requirement: Every section schema.blocks array MUST include {'type': '@app'} for App Extensions compatibility.

best_practices: Use scoped CSS classes with .dnk- prefix.
Use media-sizes-scope snippet to pass calculated sizes down to nested image blocks.
Avoid tight coupling: blocks should communicate via DOM CustomEvents rather than direct JavaScript references.
Animate using [data-dnk-animating] attribute for 60fps transitions without style-based reflows.

core_cart_operations.purpose: Initialize brand new headless or AJAX cart with optional lines and buyer identity.
Add merchandise variant lines with custom attributes and selling plan allocations.
Update item quantities or attributes dynamically without page reload.
Apply or remove coupon codes in real-time.

cart_schema_invariants: Always query lines.edges.node.merchandise for image, title, selectedOptions.

theme_check.description: Flag use of {% include %} instead of {% render %}.
Ensure section and block schemas have valid non-empty names or t: keys.
Ensure HTML translations inside locales/*.json are syntactically valid.
Flag scripts in <head> missing defer, async, or type='module'.
Disallow loading CSS/JS from unpkg, cdn.jsdelivr.net, or external domains.
Require explicit width and height attributes to avoid CLS.
Check that individual CSS assets do not exceed 100KB uncompressed.
Hard platform error if templates/*.json exceeds 512,000 bytes (512 KB).
